meta.title: Recreate with Custom end time left empty

plan.title: Recreate Order with Empty Custom End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the stage Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog is open before entering the invalid schedule.
Select Custom end time and leave its value empty.
Submit the recreate form with the empty Custom end time.
Verify Procol refuses the request with the expected validation message.
Confirm no new event was created because the recreate dialog remains open after refusal.
